product_contract: Player screen activity immediately pauses host actions; a bounded, opt-in host session may resume after trustworthy desktop inactivity. This pauses host control, never the Sims simulation.
policy: No screen-control grant without explicit session ACTIVE
Unknown/stale input age or sensor failure means pause
Any observed recent desktop input blocks host takeover, whether or not Sims is foreground
Operator-declared playing and player-directed queue block even after timeout
Cursor on game canvas alone is not permanent human activity if desktop idle is independently confirmed
Two fresh probes before each action; no reusable batch lease
Execute at most one UI step per admission; subsequent steps require new grant and independent scene check
All scripts that click/focus the Sims UI must adopt gate before shared-control claims

single_writer.scope: per actual game process ID under ignored dist/host-listener/
single_writer.acquire: before focus and until one action receipt finishes
single_writer.stale: no automatic age-based takeover; deliberate cleanup only after checking no active owner
single_writer.coverage: needs_force action boundary now; other direct UI adapters not yet migrated
